description: Estimate a transaction’s base and priority fee from its signer count and Compute Budget instructions, then simulate it to report consumed compute units and execution errors. It never broadcasts or signs. Priority cost is only calculable when both a compute-unit limit and price are present. Cost: 1 credit (0.0022 SOL). Example: {"transaction":"<base64 serialized VersionedTransaction>","network":"devnet"}

network.description: Solana cluster to query. Use mainnet-beta for real assets or devnet for test data; defaults to mainnet-beta.

transaction.description: Base64-encoded serialized VersionedTransaction. Legacy transaction serialization is not accepted.

name: estimate_transaction_cost
